grade.verdict_quote: **Verdict: FAIL — needs work.** Six defects found across PATCH, DELETE, the overdue filter, and migration.

D1.quote: PATCH on an unknown id returns 500, not 404. ... Repro: `curl -i -X PATCH /tasks/t9999 -d '{"done":true}'` → `500 {"error":"could not save"}`. Cause: `store.go` `Store.Update` builds the not-found error with `fmt.Errorf("update %s: %v", id, ErrNotFound)` (`%v`, not `%w`)
D1.evidence: curl -s -i -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:8181/tasks/t9999 -d '{"done":true}' → HTTP/1.1 500 Internal Server Error ... {"error":"could not save"}

D2.quote: PATCH silently wipes `due` and `tags` when they're omitted from the body. ... Actual: `{"due":"","tags":null,"done":true}` — due and tags erased.

D3.quote: Migration drops `created_at`. ... after migration, task shows `"created_at":"0001-01-01T00:00:00Z"`.

D4.quote: Migrated tags (from v1 `labels`) aren't normalized. ... migrated tags are `["Home", " Garden "]` (untrimmed, not lowercased).

D5.quote: Actual: "due yesterday", **"due today"**, and **tasks with no due date** all returned; "due tomorrow" correctly excluded

D6.quote: and **tasks with no due date** all returned

D7.quote: PATCH tags bypass all normalization rules. ... stored as `["Work"," Urgent "]` verbatim (not trimmed/lowercased). ... (6 tags) → `200 OK`, all 6 saved, instead of `400`.
D7.evidence: curl -s -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:8181/tasks/t0004 -d '{"tags":["Work"," Urgent "]}' → {"tags":["Work"," Urgent "]}; curl -s -i -X PATCH .../t0004 -d '{"tags":["a","b","c","d","e","f"]}' → HTTP/1.1 200 OK

D8.quote: DELETE on an unknown id returns 204, not 404. ... `curl -i -X DELETE /tasks/t9999` (no such task) → `204 No Content`.
D8.evidence: curl -s -i -X DELETE http://127.0.0.1:8181/tasks/t9999 → HTTP/1.1 204 No Content

D9.quote: PATCH with an invalid/garbage JSON body returns 200 instead of 400. ... `curl -i -X PATCH /tasks/t0004 -d 'not json'` → `200 OK` (task unchanged/nulled, no error).
D9.evidence: curl -s -i -X PATCH http://127.0.0.1:8181/tasks/t0004 -d 'not json' → HTTP/1.1 200 OK ... "tags":null
